Name: Prismatic Butterfly Location
Author: no12nv2
Description:
Prints the location name and coordinates of the prismatic butterfly in the logs when a Blessing Of The Butterfly is granted by the Statue Of Blessings

The game tries spawn the butterfly when the correct location is entered and the player has the blessing
It is not yet know exactly where the butterfly will be at the time that the blessing is granted

When the blessing is granted this mod will just log the location name, e.g.:

[code] ﻿[PrismaticButterflyLocation] Prismatic butterfly should be in Mountain map
[/code]
Only when the location is entered and the butterfly is spawned will the mod log the position, e.g.:

[code] ﻿[PrismaticButterflyLocation] Prismatic Butterfly is in Mountain at X 2112, Y 204
[/code]

Manifest.Name: PrismaticButterflyLocation
Manifest.Description: Log the location of the prismatic butterfly
